# Straight Flush Plumbing & Leak Detection

> Family-owned, diagnose-first plumbing and leak detection company based in Laguna Niguel, California. Serving South and Central Orange County since 2019. Slogan: "Always A Safe Bet."

Straight Flush Plumbing & Leak Detection specializes in finding hidden water leaks and slab leaks using acoustic, electronic, and thermal imaging technology. The company confirms the exact source of a leak before recommending any repair, demolition, or repiping. Owner-operator Lance answers the phone directly — no call center. Headquarters: 78 Cameray Heights, Laguna Niguel, CA 92677. Phone: (949) 374-6524. Email: straightflushplumbing03@gmail.com. Rated 4.8/5 on Yelp (74+ reviews) and 5.0/5 on Google.

## Core differentiators (what sets us apart)
- Diagnose-first philosophy: acoustic + electronic + thermal detection pinpoints leaks to within inches before any concrete or drywall is opened.
- Owner answers the phone and shows up on time.
- No unnecessary upselling — we tell you when you do not need us.
- Local South Orange County specialist with deep knowledge of 1970s–1990s copper systems, clay soils, and hard water conditions common in the region.
- Interactive tools on the website: Plumbing Health Score risk assessment and "Hear the Difference" acoustic leak sound comparison.

## Core services
- [Leak Detection](https://straightflushplumbingoc.com/services/leak-detection.html): Acoustic, electronic, and thermal detection of hidden water leaks without unnecessary demolition.
- [Slab Leak Detection](https://straightflushplumbingoc.com/services/slab-leak-detection.html): Core specialty — pinpointing leaks beneath concrete foundations with minimal disruption.
- [PEX Repiping](https://straightflushplumbingoc.com/services/pex-repiping.html): Whole-house repiping and copper line elimination — recommended only when truly needed.
- [Water Heater Services](https://straightflushplumbingoc.com/services/water-heater-services.html): Repair, replacement, and tankless conversion.
- [Drain Services](https://straightflushplumbingoc.com/services/drain-services.html): Drain cleaning and sewer line diagnostics.
- [Plumbing Repair](https://straightflushplumbingoc.com/services/plumbing-repair.html): Faucets, toilets, pipe repair, water pressure issues.
